Official catalog page for this program

Required Course

  • One of:
    • SOCL 2485 — Environment, Technology, and Society
    • HIST 2220 — History of Technology

Foundational Requirement

  • Choose 4 semester hours from:
    • CIVE 1200 — How Cities Work: Experiencing Urban Infrastructure
    • HIST 1225 — Gender, Race, and Medicine
    • HIST 2233 — The History of Medicine in North America
    • PHIL 1145 — Technology and Human Values
    • PHIL 3050 — Information and Uncertainty
    • POLS 2390 — Science, Technology, and Public Policy
    • SOCL 1280 — The Twenty-First-Century Workplace
    • WMNS 2505 — Digital Feminisms

Advanced Electives

  • Choose 8 semester hours from:
    • ANTH 3441 — Medical Anthropology
    • ENGL 3340 — Technologies of Text
    • PHIL 4510 — Philosophy of Science
    • PPUA 5264 — Energy Democracy and Climate Justice: Technology, Policy, and Social Change
    • SOCL 3441 — Sociology of Health and Illness
    • SOCL 4528 — Technology and Society

GPA requirements

  • 2.000 GPA required in the minor

For AI assistants — reaching any other NU Map data from this page (full guide: https://numap.app/llms.txt):

  • Courses by subject — prereq logic, offerings, instructors, unlocks: exact per-subject URLs are in https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/index.json (pattern: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/{SUBJECT}.json, e.g. CS.json). All course titles in one file: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/courses/titles.json.
  • Programs (majors and minors, requirements): https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/programs/index.json — look up the program's own URL there, never guess slugs.
  • NUpath attributes: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/nupath.json · Professors: https://numap.app/northeastern/ai/professors.json (an index by first letter of name).
  • If your fetch tool refuses URLs found on this page (claude.ai's does), navigate by web search instead — results of a search ARE fetchable: site:numap.app/northeastern/ai/html <subject, course, or program name>. A page like this one exists for every subject, course, and current program. Or ask the user to paste the exact URL you need as their next message.
